core_requests: core/links.py (P311): support setting-gated pack links (e.g. a 'requires_setting' field) so P128's off-by-default WhatsApp/Telegram links (setting phone_messaging_links) can live in v3lum/data/pivot_links/phone.json; pivots_phone emits them meanwhile.

core/links.py (P311): accept placeholder-less pack links for static manual-entry pages behind a CAPTCHA (e.g. x_manual_entry with antibot=true): ABR Telecom's Consulta Numero takes no URL parameter, and today only an inline Module.manual_link may lack a placeholder; pivots_phone emits it as an inline-pack PivotLink rendered through links.render.

Renderers (WP13/WP14, P311 cond 5, A2): apply the TLP presentation to every case link including module res.link entries (non-clickable text with 'opening sends <value> to <host>' at AMBER and above, hidden at RED except in `v3lum links`). ModuleResult.link carries only (label, url), so pivots_phone writes the warning into the label and emits nothing at RED.

Engine/links: no core path renders privacy pack links yet (_finish and `v3lum links` use links_for, which excludes them). Wire pivot_links_for(entity, include_privacy=True) for analyst-typed seeds of an opted-in case, and expose that opt-in as one core helper: pivots_phone mirrors engine._manual_link's rule (is_seed and show_personal and purpose).
core/datasets.py: feed BUNDLED_LICENCES from the notices registry (P330) so bundled-file citations carry their licence; phone_parse/br_ddd.json is cited with licence ''.

WP17/P172 (core/ioc.py): reuse v3lum.modules.phone.phone_parse.extract_phones for P172 cond 6, or move it into core/ioc.py. It runs PhoneNumberMatcher over candidate windows with a cap of 100 and withholds CPF-shaped 11-digit strings. The whole-text matcher silently stops after 65,535 failed candidates.

core/entities.py normalize_phone reads os.environ V3LUM_DEFAULT_REGION, not the configured default_region setting: a region set with `v3lum config set default_region` does not reach phone entity normalisation (phone_parse's text extraction reads ctx.setting('default_region')).

A6 dependency licence check (WP29): phonenumbers (Apache-2.0) is the core extra 'full' used by phone_parse and entities.normalize_phone; list it in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. This batch added no fragment for it, to avoid a duplicate of the core's.
notes: P126 phone_parse is an offline module (disclosure none, requires_packages phonenumbers = core extra 'full', no registry source). Phone entities (the core E.164; FC1 no re-normalisation) get these attributes: valid, line_type, phone_formats, country, region (DDD UF), city (landline city-level geodescription only), phone_geodescription, timezone, phone_br, phone_ddd (uf/ufs/main_city, the city list only from brasilapi_ddd, else coverage 'city list unavailable (run v3lum data update brasilapi_ddd)'), original_carrier {name, label 'original carrier (portability not reflected)'}, plus info findings: not valid, non-geographic (0800/0300/0303/0500/0900/400x), and the time-zone caveat (libphonenumber gives DDD 81 Noronha UTC-2). text_blob/file inputs (FC4) run PhoneNumberMatcher with the default_region setting over candidate windows, capped at 100 distinct numbers; the pivots are phone, relation mentions, expand=False with the AR07 note, and the engine lists them in case.pending_personal. FC3: v3lum/data/phone_parse/br_ddd.json was GENERATED by the maintainer entry point phone_parse.main from Anatel's Cadastro Nacional de Localidades public download (sistemas.anatel.gov.br, LoPubCNL layout; the CN comes from the 'Cod.Nacional' fields). Main city = the state capital when it is an area centre of the DDD, else MAIN_CITY_OVERRIDES: the most populous Anatel area centre per IBGE Censo 2022, reviewed. ufs = main UF plus bordering UFs (DDD 61 DF+GO; 42/47/49 PR+SC border towns). Two CNL anomalies are excluded and listed (Bariri/SP in 48, Boa Esperanca do Norte/MT in 51). The table is registered in notice phone_parse_br_ddd (sha256 recorded), and a trimmed real CNL fixture regenerates it exactly in the tests. FC5: correlation rule phone_ddd_region_consistency (v3lum/correlations/p1_g06_1.py) compares a phone's DDD states with a linked CPF's fiscal region (validators.cpf_region, offline; CPF shown masked and keyed by hash) and the 'region' state of a linked CEP/CNPJ node. It reports mismatches only, with severity info, confidence possible and tags weak_signal and context_only: never a fraud verdict. FC6 (Anatel numbering open data) is deferred by the council and re-checked unreachable/walled: docs/backlog/p1-G06-1.md. P128: data pack v3lum/data/pivot_links/phone.json (spamcalls_num, https://spamcalls.net/en/num/{e164} where the core {e164} = digits without '+', labelled 'user reports, unverified', privacy=true). The pivots_phone module (offline, run_on seeds) registers setting phone_messaging_links (default false) and, for analyst-typed seeds of an opted-in case (show_personal + purpose; else SKIPPED privacy), emits the pack link, ABR Telecom's static Consulta Numero page for +55 numbers and, when enabled, wa.me/{digits} and t.me/+{digits} with the FC2 notice. At AMBER and above the labels carry 'opening sends <number> to <host>'; at RED nothing is emitted (SKIPPED tlp). Every link goes through links.render (P311 lint, registry tiers). Provider fragments created: spamcalls (community, reuses_queries=true; publishes_queries pending a legal_dpo decision on its public request counters), whatsapp (wa.me, trusted), abrtelecom (trusted); t.me uses the seeded telegram provider (source phone_links). With the wave-2 policy gate both modules need a recorded --purpose for phone seeds (POL-07, core rule). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant was requested. No proposal is undone; deferrals and deviations are in docs/backlog/p1-G06-1.md.
